contribute.title: Suggest a resource
contribute.intro: Point out a course, article, book, thesis, video or exercise that is useful to other students.
contribute.ruleLink: The platform lists the resource and points to its official source: it copies no file.
contribute.ruleRights: Only suggest resources that are lawfully accessible.
contribute.ruleReview: Each suggestion is checked by the moderators before being published.

contributions.intro: Follow the status of the resources you have suggested.
contributions.empty: You have not suggested any resource yet.

notices.updated: Your corrected suggestion has been sent back to the moderators.

moderation.intro: Check the source, licence and link of each resource before publishing it.
moderation.reasonHint: Required to request changes, reject, suspend or remove. It is shown to the contributor.
moderation.correctIntro: Changing the link, licence or access status of a published record sends it back for verification.

sharing.heading: Sharing
sharing.intro: Invite your supervisor to read your project. Without an invitation, only you can read it.

DataExport.excludes: It contains neither deleted projects awaiting erasure nor your account's security event log: ask support for those.

Tasks.introMember: What remains to be done on this project. You only change the tasks you set.
Tasks.openHeading: {count, plural, =0 {No task in progress} one {# task in progress} other {# tasks in progress}}
Tasks.doneHeading: {count, plural, one {# completed task} other {# completed tasks}}

fields.title: What needs to be done
fields.dueDateHint: In the format YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-11-30.

Tasks.noticeDone: The task has been marked as done.

Notifications.title: Notifications
Notifications.intro: What has happened on the projects you write or follow.
Notifications.loadFailed: Notifications could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
Notifications.unread: {count, plural, =0 {Everything is read.} one {# unread notification.} other {# unread notifications.}}

kinds.version_submitted: A version of “{project}” has been submitted to you
kinds.version_decided: Decision given on a version of “{project}”

Notifications.noticeRead: Your notifications are marked as read.

email.title: Email
email.on: You receive an email when new notifications are waiting for you.
email.off: You do not receive emails for your notifications.
email.hint: At most one email a day. It only says there is something new: neither the project nor what happened appears in it. Every email lets you unsubscribe.
email.noticeOn: You will receive an email when new notifications are waiting for you.
email.noticeOff: You will no longer receive emails for your notifications.

Unsubscribe.title: Notification emails
Unsubscribe.intro: You can stop receiving the emails that tell you about new notifications. Your notifications remain readable in EduScholar.
Unsubscribe.done: If this link was valid, you will no longer receive these emails.
Unsubscribe.reactivate: You can ask for them again from the “Notifications” page of your account.
